checks.description: at least one GPU node is Ready and advertises exactly one nvidia.com/gpu
checks.because: The NVIDIA device plugin turns each GPU into a schedulable nvidia.com/gpu. One experiment is one pod holding one GPU, so the number of experiments that run at once is the number of these lines.

checks.description: Kueue holds one research queue with a GPU quota and two priorities (interactive above sweep-low)
checks.because: Terraform installs Kueue; the tests apply the queue and the priority classes. A sweep is submitted at sweep-low so that a run somebody is waiting for goes first.

checks.description: every family in the registry satisfies the contract (owner, versioned data with a held-out split, verifier, eval suite and margin) and its data version is the one the code generates
checks.because: A family joins the mixture only as an entry that has all of these. The check also compares the registry's data version with the version string the generator carries, so a change to the data that nobody recorded would fail it.

checks.description: every verifier accepts all the known-right answers and none of the known-wrong ones (seven families, 200 of each)
checks.because: A verifier is the family's definition of 'right'. The known answers are built from each example's own ground truth (the gold solution, the exact call, the refusal or the substantive answer), so a verifier that is too lax or too strict shows up here before any training does.

checks.description: no prompt of any family's training pool appears in any family's held-out set
checks.because: The held-out parts are carved out of each family's own lists (topics, argument values, countries, requests) before the generators run, and the check is cross-domain: it looks at every training pool against every evaluation set, not only a family against itself.

checks.description: the first run was admitted by Kueue, trained three steps, and wrote a per-family record for every batch and a per-family evaluation at the start and the end
checks.because: The run is an Indexed Job with a queue label. Kueue creates a Workload, checks the quota and unsuspends the job. The per-family records are what every later scenario reads.

checks.description: the software is the pinned set (vLLM 0.33.0, TRL 1.18.2, transformers 5.24.0)
checks.because: The pod runs the vLLM image and installs TRL and transformers at pinned versions; the run writes the versions it imported, not the ones I intended.
